name: connection-broker
description: Holds credentials for and talks to the external systems a Connection CR names (docs/adr/0038 §3): runs the provider drivers, serves incremental listing and fetch to the sync worker, and answers per-user authorization probes (docs/adr/0040) for retrieval. Deliberately a separate Deployment from agent-orchestrator, so third-party credentials and outbound egress stay out of the pod holding cluster RBAC.
